entry.title: Your Voice Assistant Can Be Social-Engineered Too, and Nobody's Watching For It
entry.summary: We spent a decade teaching people not to click the phishing link. Now we've built agents that will happily take instructions from whatever's playing in the background, and we haven't even started teaching them not to. entry.title: Scaling Properties of Text Conditioning in Visual Generation
entry.summary: We study empirical scaling properties for text conditioning in visual generation.
